segments.name: Allogeneic CAR-T Cell Therapies
segments.description: Clinical-stage development of allogeneic off-the-shelf CAR-T cell therapies for treating hematologic malignancies using proprietary chRDNA genome-editing technology.
segments.evidence: We operate and manage our business as one reportable segment and one operating segment, which is the business of developing allogeneic CAR-T cell therapies.

revenueModel.text: The company receives licensing and collaboration revenue from licensees through nonrefundable upfront fees, maintenance fees, milestone payments, and royalties on commercialized products.
revenueModel.evidence: Payments to us under these arrangements typically include one or more of the following: nonrefundable upfront license fees, maintenance fees, milestones, and other contingent payments to us for the achievement of defined collaboration objectives and certain nonclinical, clinical, regulatory, and sales-based events, as well as royalties on sales of any commercialized products.
